title: Lattice pricing - $10-$11/seat/month, $4,000/year minimum agreement
clean_text: Lattice's two core plans are Talent Management at $11/seat/month (performance, with add-ons for engagement, compensation, and growth) and HRIS at $10/seat/month (complete HR management with payroll add-ons available), both billed annually on a per-seat basis. The Engagement add-on costs an additional $4/seat/month. A minimum annual agreement of $4,000 applies regardless of headcount, meaning a 10-person team pays $4,000/year -- well above what straight per-seat math would suggest.
